patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Cognism share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Bombora only if your buying job matches “Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact dat” rather than Cognism's shape. Choose Cognism only if your buying job matches “Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobiles, strong ” rather than Bombora's shape. Workflow advantage: Bombora leans lead-management; Cognism leans contact-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bombora and Cognism share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Bombora is Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact database; custom-quote packaging.; Cognism is Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobiles, strong EMEA coverage, and CRM enrichment — quote-led Sale.
- Workflow coverage skew: Bombora-leaning lead-management vs Cognism-leaning contact-management.
- Researched limits: Bombora — Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Cognism — Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach.

Limitations — Bombora: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Custom-quote only via speak-to-an-expert path; Cognism: Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach; Sales Prospecting Standard/Pro list prices are not published on /pricing.

Poor-fit cases: Bombora is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database · Cognism is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach · Avoid Bombora if you actually need Cognism's motion (Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobile)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
